title: Execute exact signed monomial packets between synthetic rounds
body:
## Summary

Make the retained synthetic transform's signed monomial data boundary executable on complete MSB-first Gaussian packets.

```text
supplied exponent E=q*r+s per record
  scan prefix and suffix into separate data tapes
  emit signed suffix, then signed prefix
  preserve source and clear all three private roles
```

PROOF.md proves the finite-parameter family, its inverse, p+2-bit disk compatibility and the data-operation bound `37N+6L+3w`, including head returns and clearing. Five data roles use `2N+2L+w` cells including input/output. The source already proves the rotation identity and asymptotic scan cost; this adds an explicit bit-level program, movement invoice and failure/restoration contract.

Only `research/synthetic-monomial-packets/` changes. Headers and loop counters remain supplied host control. Rounded transform fixtures use a rational simultaneous-butterfly reference and the retained indexed layout engine. This supplies one part of PR3493/3504's outer-round handoff, with no production T74 round, supplier, new kappa or selected-frontier change.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the retained synthetic audit acts on indexed coefficient lists and leaves the bit-packet movement boundary outside its scope. **After:** 32,370 signed-word/phase cases, four mixed packets through 128-bit words, seven data/header/extent rejections with valid retry, eight rounded forward/opposite transforms and 2,240 exact component-error checks pass.
- Seven optimized actual CLI controls reject unsigned wrap, lost negative quotient, wrong negation, split Gaussian components, wrong opposite phase, altered source and missing source. The valid optimized control passes.
- CPython 3.12 registered replay and scoped Ruff pass. The actual final-head committed-byte/source-history gate and Git-free normal/optimized scientific replay plus CLI controls pass. Exported source hashes, modes and identities remain unchanged. The publication's three canonical inputs are declared and authenticated; pending comparison heads are explicit non-dependency receipts.

```sh
TMPDIR=/absolute/private/run python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/synthetic-monomial-packets
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/synthetic-monomial-packets --check-source-history
```

Canonical baseline/submission refresh is `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`, priority revision 6. Final overlap covers 425 open PRs and 2,350 Discussion records with complete pagination and no warnings; arbitrary code diffs and all closed PRs are outside that scan.

Credit Philipp `mightyOil` for the positional engine, Jose Manuel `jmbarrancoml` for signed packing/PR2298, Douglas Colkitt and the retained synthetic source, and its Nussbaumer/Quandalle and Harvey/van der Hoeven lineage. PR3087 already implements encoded Gaussian i-phases and affine address monomials on LSB fields; this package rotates polynomial y-coefficients inside records with MSB words and supplied headers. No first signed-negation primitive or encoded-controller improvement is claimed. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. The next task is an encoded exponent producer joined to an actual physical root with a complete control/data invoice. Existing source notices and selected evidence are unchanged. Canonical family discussion: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

A new opt-in research package. No shared runtime, frozen input or selected record changes. Executable capacity bounds, managed-runtime deviations and unrun physical obligations are explicit in README.md and ENGINEERING.md.
